mapper.select: SELECT E.EMP_ID AS empId, E.EMP_NM AS empNm, E.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, D.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, D.PRNT_DEPT_CD AS parentDeptCd, E.JOB_GRD_CD AS jobGrdCd, JG.JOB_GRD_NM AS jobGrdNm, JG.SORT_ORDER AS jobGrdSortOrder, E.JOB_PSTN_CD AS jobPstnCd, JP.JOB_PSTN_NM AS jobPstnNm, E.JOB_DUTY_CN AS jobDutyCn, E.EXEC_YN AS execYn, CASE WHEN E.EMP_STAMP_FILE_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS hasSignatureYn, CASE WHEN D.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS deptLeaderYn, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID AS prflImgFileId FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE JG ON JG.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION JP ON JP.JOB_PSTN_CD = E.JOB_PSTN_CD WHERE E.ENABLED = 'Y' AND E.EMP_ID <> #{empId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN E.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN D.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN E.EMP_STAMP_FILE_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, NVL(JG.SORT_ORDER, 9999), E.EMP_ID FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
